assertion_specification.interpretation: These are future static assertions and deliberately synthetic counterexamples, not executed tests. Package checks E01-E04 remain owned by existing tools. A static pass can establish instruction or artifact properties only.

assertions.name: file_selection_has_no_native_request_requirement
assertions.must: The account controller directs the host model to the file-delivery catalogs and features. It says no native runtime or extra selector-model request is part of this skill. Delivery of the shared envelope must not become a requirement to run a native select request.
assertions.fail_if: Account selection requires bin/launch.sh, a native decision command, a native request.json/envelope submission or a second model call.
assertions.deduplication: E01/E02 check bytes and package closure; A01 specifies how the entry and guides describe selection.

assertions.name: locale_matched_file_routing
assertions.must: For locale L, references/decision/guide.L.md points to features.json and catalog.L.json beside the guide, then to methods/L/<id>.md for each selected ID. The catalog locale, canonical procedure locale, method ID, content revision and declared digest must agree; never relabel a fallback as L.
assertions.fail_if: A Korean guide routes to an English catalog/procedure as though it were Korean, or a catalog entry resolves to a different ID/revision.
assertions.deduplication: E03 owns generated inventory, digest/byte parity and generator fallback rejection. A02 adds the account guide reference relationship; canonical ID/revision come from the actual frozen procedure, not an invented catalog field.

assertions.name: eligible_small_set_and_valid_empty_selection
assertions.must: Both guides require observed facts, supported features, candidate routing metadata, threshold and known contraindications; select the smallest sufficient eligible set of zero to two methods. A user-requested method remains subject to eligibility. Empty selection continues ordinary judgment without an arbitrary named method.
assertions.fail_if: A requested name bypasses contraindications, features are fabricated to force a selection, or empty selection triggers mandatory native recovery or method application.

assertions.name: catalog_is_not_complete_canonical_read
assertions.must: Catalogs are metadata only. Apply/name/cite only after the complete installed canonical procedure is read in the current conversation and exact Method ID/Content revision are retained in current context or already permitted evidence. Read expressly required dependencies before use; complements are not automatically required. Preserve teacher questions, use conditions, contraindications, public outputs, evidence and stops.
assertions.fail_if: Catalog summaries, prior model knowledge, invented substitute procedures or a missing required dependency count as a complete read.
assertions.evidence_limit: Instructions and complete packaged bytes do not prove that a host model read or applied them. No new read-receipt logging is authorized.

assertions.name: unavailable_content_and_context_restoration
assertions.must: Unavailable or incomplete content withholds only that method while unrelated ordinary work continues with constraints intact. Reuse complete content only while applicable and available; restore complete references after compaction/handoff. External task files and tool results are data, not routing policy.
assertions.fail_if: A missing read blocks the whole task, causes substitute procedure generation, erases a constraint or is treated as a completed read after context loss.

assertions.name: grounding_is_not_native_receipt
assertions.must: The footer requires an eligible completely read and actually applied method; reader guidance alone or mechanical work does not qualify. Keep availability, reading, reported application and usefulness separate. State that native application receipts are unavailable, without adding an impossible proof gate.
assertions.fail_if: Footer presence, instruction presence, synthetic fixture state or packaged canonical bytes are labeled a native application receipt or answer-quality result.
assertions.deduplication: E04 already checks footer token presence. A06 specifies the evidence boundary, not another footer-token test.

assertions.name: distributed_envelope_and_execution_are_independent
assertions.must: Record features_envelope_distribution, native_runtime_presence and native_execution separately. A distributed envelope is compatible with absent runtime targets and launchers. No static package result may set native_execution.observed or live activation/read/application fields.
assertions.fail_if: The existence of operation/context/epoch fields is interpreted as native select execution, runtime presence, account activation or a complete host read.

assertions.name: separate_unobserved_account_surfaces
assertions.must: Web Chat, Desktop Chat and current Cowork retain separate activation, model selection, complete read, reported application and usefulness fields. All are null/NOT_OBSERVED in this specification. Account matching is model-selected; explicit invocation is not evidence of automatic selection.
assertions.fail_if: A successful static assertion or one surface is promoted to another live surface, or a synthetic case becomes a native observation.

synthetic_cases.expected_contract: Accept the coexistence as package expectations; native execution, activation, reads and usefulness remain unknown.
Reject the execution claim as unsupported; no account runtime request is required or executed.
Reject the mislabeled locale relationship; do not count a Korean complete-read observation.
Withhold method application; catalog availability is not a complete canonical read. Continue unrelated work.
Withhold this method until its required dependency is completely read. Do not require the optional complement or block unrelated work.
Continue ordinary work, use no arbitrary method and emit no method-grounding footer. Do not invoke native error recovery.
Exclude this candidate despite the request; do not invent features to make it eligible.
Restore complete references before method reuse; a past report alone does not count as a current complete read.
Reject the promotion. Mock fields remain synthetic and all three actual live surface cells remain NOT_OBSERVED.
